event: Heavy downpour / waterlogging, Vadodara (PRECEDENT: outside the Aug-2024/Sep-2023 window)
what_was_disclosed: All plants except Hydrogen section of Ammonia-IV and GTG section of cogeneration affected; precautionary shutdown due to power interruption from 66 KV sub-station; phased restart 1 Aug 2019
source_quote: On account of heavy down pour close to 20 inches (499 mm) within a span of 12 hours on 31st July, 2019 and subsequent water logging in plant areas, all plants except Hydrogen Section of Ammonia-IV Plant and GTG Section of Cogeneration plant were effected in the Vadodara Unit of the Company.
